summary: BuzzFeed, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two share purchase agreements dated June 17, 2026. Under the first, Allen Family Digital, LLC (Byron Allen's family office affiliate) purchased 4,000,000 shares (2,173,155 newly issued, 1,826,845 treasury) at $1.44/share, the June 15 closing price, for ~$5.8 million. Under the second, individual purchasers bought 216,999 shares at the same price. Both were board-approved, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), and closed June 18. This private placement is not a transformative special situation; it is a routine capital raise with no premium or change of control.
